summary: Living room is well kept with a few tip-over and tripping risks.

hazards.title: Unsecured Tall Plant
hazards.detail: Top-heavy potted tree can easily be pulled down or knocked over.
fixSteps: Place into a wider, weighted base planter.
Secure the upper stem to the wall using a discreet tether.

hazards.title: Slender Tabletop Vase
hazards.detail: Tall slender vase with branches on coffee table is easily tipped over.
fixSteps: Move fragile vase to a stable, low-traffic credenza.
Use museum putty under the base to prevent spills or falls.

hazards.title: Low Table Leg Trip Risk
hazards.detail: Low-profile coffee table edges sit close to chair pathways.
fixSteps: Shift table further from seating to open up walking clearance.
Ensure clear, unobstructed walkways around all sides.

products.name: Museum Putty
products.reason: Secures tabletop vase and decor from knocking over.

products.name: Plant Wall Anchor Strap
products.reason: Prevents the top-heavy fiddle-leaf fig from falling.
products.searchQuery: furniture and plant safety wall straps
